items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Well yeah, he played all those heavy overtures, operas, you know opera numbers. He conducted them beautiful too.

ctx.x: What kind of an orchestra did he conduct? Do you remember hearing any concerts?
Well yeah, he played all those heavy overtures, operas, you know opera numbers. He conducted them beautiful too. He really was marvelous to them. I think he was the greatest in the awards.
And the musicians who were in his big orchestra?
